boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's FS_overlay.c, 0x0205db88..0x0205e0f4: 10 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Nine are identified by their bodies against pret's pokediamond FS_overlay.c. FS_ClearOverlayImage invalidates the I- and D-cache over image and bss and zeroes the bss. FS_GetOverlayFileID returns the ROM archive and the header's file_id. FSi_LoadOverlayInfoCore bounds-checks the entry against the target's table region, opens it with FS_OpenFileDirect and reads the 0x20-byte header. FS_LoadOverlayInfo copies the entry from the in-memory table (fsi_ovt9 or fsi_ovt7) when there is one, else calls FSi_LoadOverlayInfoCore with fsi_arc_rom and the ROM header's regions. FSi_CompareDigest HMACs with the digest key and compares 20 bytes a word at a time. FS_StartOverlay checks the multiboot child's digest, decompresses and runs sinit_init..sinit_init_end. FS_EndOverlay unlinks and runs __global_destructor_chain entries in the overlay. FS_UnloadOverlayImage and FS_UnloadOverlay are pret's.

FS_AttachOverlayTable belongs to this file. It calls FSi_CompareDigest, which pret's FS_overlay.c defines, and checks against data_0209a7d8, the 20-byte digest directly below data_0209a7ec, the per-overlay digest table FS_StartOverlay indexes. It writes the fsi_ovt9 and fsi_ovt7 regions FS_LoadOverlayInfo reads. Its place fits: it sits directly below FS_UnloadOverlay, pret's last function, so it was defined after it. FSi_OnRomReadDone at 0x0205db78, pret's first FS_rom.c function and the top of arm9/FS_Rom, ends the run below. pret dead-strips it, but NitroSDK fs_overlay.c defines it as its last function, FS_AttachOverlayTable(target, ptr, len): for an ARM9 table, switch DGT to overlay-table mode, panic unless FSi_CompareDigest(SDK_OVERLAYTABLE_DIGEST, ptr, len), restore the mode, then store ptr and len in fsi_ovt9 or fsi_ovt7 with interrupts disabled. The body is that, step for step.

Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse. pret's file order is FS_ClearOverlayImage, FS_GetOverlayFileID, FSi_LoadOverlayInfoCore, FS_LoadOverlayInfo, FSi_CompareDigest, FS_StartOverlay, FS_EndOverlay, FS_UnloadOverlayImage, FS_UnloadOverlay, and the ROM holds it reversed. Older SDK: FSi_GetOverlayBinarySize, FS_LoadOverlayImageAsync, FS_LoadOverlayImage and FS_LoadOverlay are absent (the game keeps its own loaders, FS_LoadOverlay at 0x02018ad0, func_02018b64 (FS_LoadOverlayImage) and func_02018c00 (FS_LoadOverlayInfo)), FSi_LoadOverlayInfoCore has no file_pos tail, and FS_StartOverlay has no DC_FlushRange.
BOTTOM EDGE: FSi_OnRomReadDone (0x0205db78..0x0205db88), the highest function of FS_rom.c (arm9/FS_Rom).
TOP EDGE: DGT_Hash2CalcHmac at 0x0205e0f4, the DGT library.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Rom: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
C++ for CP15:: (FS_ClearOverlayImage); every function keeps C linkage.
Text-only: the digest key (data_0209a04c, data_0209a050) and the digest tables stay in the data link.

FS_GetOverlayFileID returns its FSFileID by value, as pret's does: as C++, the old out-parameter form lost its stack temporary (0x18 bytes, not 0x28), and the by-value form matches. Its callers LoadOverlay and func_02018b64 take the same form and still match. struct Pair is the SDK's FSFileID. Those callers spell it Pair too, and a rename would change their declarations.
